chapter.heading: Ezekiel 47
Water Flowing from the Temple
chapter.v: 47 Then he brought me back tothe door of the temple, and behold, water was issuing from below the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east). The water was flowing down from below the south end of the threshold of the temple, south of the altar.
the outer gate that faces toward the east; and behold, the water was trickling out on the south side.
the man measured a thousand cubits, and then led me through the water, and it was ankle-deep.
Again he measured a thousand, and led me through the water, and it was knee-deep. Again he measured a thousand, and led me through the water, and it was waist-deep.
Again he measured a thousand, and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the water had risen. It was deep enough to swim in, a river that could not be passed through.
Then he led me back to the bank of the river.
